 11 Nov 2026 
 3 minute read 
 Deadline for outstanding CRS submissions and corrections ahead of AEOI Portal suspension 
 The Malta Tax and Customs Administration (MTCA) has announced an upcoming deadline for Reporting Financial Institutions (RFIs) to submit outstanding Common Reporting Standard (CRS) reports and corrections relating to reporting periods 2025 and earlier, ahead of the implementation of the new CRS XML Schema V3.0 in 2027
 Print 
 Share 
 Submission deadline: 18 November 2026
 In its recent notice, the MTCA has advised that all outstanding CRS submissions, including missing returns and correction files relating to reporting periods 2025 and earlier, must be submitted by 18 November 2026 .
 The deadline applies to submissions made through both available reporting channels:
 The Automatic Exchange of Information (AEOI) Portal; and
 Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP).
 Temporary suspension of reporting facilities
 As part of the transition to CRS XML Schema V3.0, the MTCA will temporarily suspend the CRS reporting facilities.
 Accordingly, both the AEOI Portal and the SFTP reporting channel will cease accepting CRS submissions as from 19 November 2026 to facilitate the necessary infrastructure updates.
 The MTCA currently anticipates that the reporting facilities will become operational again by 1 March 2027 . Upon their reinstatement, RFIs will be able to submit CRS reports and correction files using the new CRS XML Schema V3.0.
 Treatment of outstanding submissions after the deadline
 Any missing CRS reports or corrections relating to reporting periods 2025 or earlier that have not been submitted by 18 November 2026 will need to be filed in 2027, following the reopening of the reporting facilities, using CRS XML Schema V3.0.
 Recommended action
 RFIs should take immediate steps to review their CRS reporting records and identify any outstanding reporting obligations relating to 2025 and earlier reporting periods.
 In particular, RFIs are encouraged to:
 Review previous CRS submissions to identify any missing or outstanding returns.
 Identify any corrections or amendments to previously submitted CRS reports that remain pending.
 Ensure that all outstanding submissions and corrections are successfully filed through the relevant reporting channel by 18 November 2026 .
 Prepare for the transition to CRS XML Schema V3.0 and the resumption of reporting activities, currently expected by 1 March 2027.
 We would be pleased to discuss whether any aspects of your current FATCA/CRS framework may warrant further consideration or a targeted review, including in light of the upcoming transition to CRS XML Schema V3.0.
 Should you wish to discuss this further or require assistance in reviewing your existing CRS reporting arrangements, please do not hesitate to contact us.
